walkthroughs.body_html:
Operations Management — a core area of GCSE Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Operations Management brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Operations Management.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is a brand in marketing?
options: Productivity is the number of employees a business has.

A combination of name, design, symbols and associations that distinguishes a product and creates customer perception and loyalty — more than just a logo.
A brand is the company that makes a product.
